observations.why: The collective 'We ratified' enacts communal-sharing — a shared body collectively endorsing a contract as one — while reporting the ratification event.

Framing a statement as a 'Key decision' and prescribing how the system 'dispatches' enacts authority-ranking — the speaker positions as decision-maker allocating operational roles — while describing the contract's command structure.

mints.name: DecisionAsDispatch
mints.title: Key decision: remember dispatches
mints.frame: Is the speaker here enacting authority by framing a design choice as a settled decision that allocates how the system must behave?
